title: Reasons for Choosing the G60
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe why owners chose the G60, focusing on driving feel, power, build quality, technology features, and dealership or salesperson influence, with a few unclear or context-limited remarks.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the G60 was chosen for its enjoyable driving, strong power, solid build quality, appealing tech features, and positive salesperson experiences.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention reasons for choosing the car or issues like self-locking and difficulty connecting with it, but the sentiment or context is too unclear to summarize more confidently.

limitations: This topic mixes purchase reasons with at least one possible problem report about the car locking itself, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Several fragments are too short or context-limited to determine clear sentiment, which restricts interpretation.
The examples are a stratified sample and do not support broader claims about how common any stated reason is.
